wordmark.purpose: The name and the closing words only.

shadows.name: sun-glow
shadows.purpose: The setting sun in the dusk band; the only glow on the page.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Reveals, cover cross-fades, the wordmark rise.

motion.name: hero-pipeline
motion.value: continuous clock, up to 2.1x when scrolling, eased over ~0.5s
motion.purpose: Raw blocks rise from the sand, are sorted in spice and ride away as teal batches.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill with a round arrow badge; the résumé and case-study links.
components.html: Résumé
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #221e1d; color: #f4f7f6; font: 500 15px Satoshi, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .3s, color .3s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #d35c11; color: #fff6ec; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d35c11; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(244 247 246 / .12); transition: transform .3s; } .ds-btn:hover .ds-btn-badge { transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(34 30 29 / .32); color: #221e1d; font: 500 15px Satoshi, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .3s; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: #221e1d; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d35c11; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Pill links; the active section is an ink pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: #221e1d; font: 500 15px Satoshi, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .3s, color .3s; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: rgb(34 30 29 / .08); } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: #221e1d; color: #e6edeb; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Tool names under a role or certificate.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d3e0dd; color: #4f5a55; font: 400 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Collapsible role row with a round plus toggle.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(34 30 29 / .14); background: none; text-align: left; font: 500 17px Satoshi, sans-serif; color: #221e1d; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row small { display: block; font: 400 12px 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: #5b6762; } .ds-row i { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(34 30 29 / .32); background: linear-gradient(#221e1d,#221e1d) center/12px 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#221e1d,#221e1d) center/1px 12px no-repeat; } .ds-row:hover i { border-color: #221e1d; }

narrative.northStar: One day over a dune field
narrative.overview: The portfolio opens at dawn in Dune Part One's mist, where buried data blocks rise and file into a stack as you scroll, and ends in Part Two's spice dusk and night. In between it is calm and light: Satoshi headings, hairline ledgers, real covers.
keyCharacteristics: Procedural WebGL dune field as the hero
Mist canvas with one spice accent
Dusk band into a night footer

rules.name: One accent per tone
rules.body: Spice by day, sun by night; no other hue.

rules.name: The turn happens once
rules.body: Mist becomes night only through the dusk band.

rules.name: Dune Rise is for names
rules.body: The name and the closing words only; never body.

dos: Do keep readouts plain: coordinates and local time.
Do use real covers and outcomes.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, section numbers or brackets.
Don't add a second accent or a custom cursor.
Don't use em or en dashes in copy.
